what: 1. Authoring Unit Tests for New Stan Include Files
title: Contributing to imuGAP
text: adding refactoring Stan include files, create unit tests following guidelines: Explicit Target Declaration & Pipelined Harness: Declare target <- "<subpath>.stan" top test file, pass target skip_if_stan_unchanged(target), assemble model harness via sprintf(...) |> compile_stan_harness(). Dynamic Expectations Input Relationships: Express test data dimensions assertions dynamically using input variables mathematical relationships (e.g. length(x), nrow(mat), c(tail(lbounds, -1) - 1L, ubound), analytical closed forms) rather hardcoding magic numbers repeatedly. Test via rstan Deterministically: Use internal test helper run_stan_harness() (defined tests/testthat/helper-stan-test.R), executes rstan::sampling() using algorithm = "Fixed_param", iter = 1, warmup = 0, chains = 1, fixed random seed. Direct Parameter Extraction & Auto-Reshaping: run_stan_harness() optionally receives parameter symbol/name (e.g. run_stan_harness(model, data = ..., out_bounds)) extracts reshapes single-iteration draw strip leading singleton iteration dimension (returning scalar, vector, matrix, array directly). Functions & Transformed Data: Pass fixed deterministic test data data assign computed values generated quantities variables direct extraction assertion expect_equal(). Likelihood & Model Priors: files evaluating target += ... ~, use run_stan_harness(..., return_fit = TRUE) evaluate rstan::log_prob(fit, upars = c(0.0), adjust_transform = FALSE). Note Stan’s sampling statement ~ drops normalization constants respect parameters, test unnormalized log-densities (e.g. sum(dbinom(...) - lchoose(...))). 1D Array Wrapping: Wrap 1D integer/numeric arrays data .array() (e.g. obs_to_weights_bounds = .array(1L)) Rstan collapse scalars. Guard every Stan test block skip_if_not_installed("rstan") skip_if_stan_unchanged(target). local development, skip_if_stan_unchanged() caches MD5 hashes tempdir() skip model recompilation (~20–25s per model) tested Stan files changed. full checks (R CMD check, _R_CHECK_PACKAGE_NAME_, CI), caching completely bypassed — tests run unconditionally read write local cache.

title: imuGAP 0.2.0
text: sampling(), canonicalize_locations(), underlying Stan models now support user-defined hierarchical location structures arbitrary depth (e.g. 1-layer statewide, 2-layer state-county, 3-layer state-county-school, deeper regional partitions). Added assemble_layer_data() helper construct validate hierarchical metadata, bounds, parent mappings. Added dedicated single-layer model impute_school_coverage_process_v6_single_layer automatic dispatch single-layer inputs supplied. Added new vignette (user_specified_layers) demonstrating 1-layer, 2-layer, 3-layer model estimation prediction workflows. Integrated flexstanr (>= 0.2.0) provide uniform backend abstraction across rstan cmdstanr MCMC engines. Re-exported flexstanr::stan_options() seamless sampler configuration. Refactored top-level Stan models concise assembly skeletons utilizing modular #include directives (functions/, data/, transformed_data/, parameters/, model/). Pruned legacy/vestigial Stan scripts streamline code base maintenance. Split target generation fit-free constructor create_target() validation function canonicalize_target(). Added bundled example fitted datasets single-layer 2-layer models (fit_sim_1layer, fit_sim_2layer, predict_sim_1layer, predict_sim_2layer, target_sim_1layer, target_sim_2layer).

title: imuGAP 0.2.0
text: Location Hierarchy Invariant: Enforced structural validation ensuring location nodes either 0 offspring (leaf) ≥2\ge 2 offspring (preventing single-child degenerate chains). Error Handling & Assertions: Standardized assertion messages across functions using module-level ERR_* format string constants helper assertion functions stop_fmt_if() warn_fmt_if(). Validation: Added validation NA weights population target specifications. Documentation Examples & Check Times: Applied combined @examplesIf interactive() \donttest{} idiom computationally heavy examples, enabling fast pkgdown builds (~35 seconds) remaining CRAN ---cran compliant. Vignette Dark Mode Compatibility: Enforced solid white backgrounds high-contrast styling across vignette plots clean rendering light/dark modes.

title: imuGAP 0.1.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-06-22 First public release. Initial feature set: sampling(): fits imuGAP Bayesian hierarchical coverage model via rstan::sampling() returns imugap_fit object wrapping underlying stanfit together model settings dataset metadata. predict.imugap_fit(): posterior-predicts coverage probabilities user-supplied target population grid using rstan::gqs(). extract_imugap(): convenience wrapper around rstan::extract() pulling common imuGAP parameters (defaults state-level B-spline coefficients beta_bs). canonicalize_locations(), canonicalize_observations(), canonicalize_populations(): validate convert user-supplied data canonical forms required sampler. imugap_options(): configures model-side settings (B-spline degrees freedom, dose schedule, model object). stan_options(): configures Stan sampler settings (iter, chains, seed, etc.) input validation. impute_school_coverage_process_v6 (adds county- school-level random effects; current default). Bundled example datasets end--end examples tests: locations_sim, observations_sim, populations_sim, latent_params_sim, predict_sim, target_sim, reference fit_sim stanfit fixture. pkgdown documentation site published https://accidda.github.io/imuGAP/.
